decisions.statement: A page's secret values are in one sops file beside that page.
One file has every secret a page has rather than one file for each secret.
A secret's value is the text given including its newlines.
An empty value is refused rather than written over a usable value.
The key names are in the open and only the values are ciphertext.
Nothing here writes the sops file.
Ciphertext is composed here and landed by the gate.
Landing the ciphertext parts a secret from an uncommitted value.
Composed ciphertext with no sops mac is refused rather than handed back.
A page with no sops file beside that page has no secrets.
A sops file that is there but will not decrypt is refused rather than read as empty.
sops is handed the plaintext on its input rather than at a path.
`--filename-override` names the sops file the ciphertext is for.
That name settles which rule encrypts, though no file sits at it.
Which key encrypts is read from the repository's `.sops.yaml` rather than said here.
The key names a file has are read without decrypting that file.

definition: the values a page carries that holding its files does not reveal
